lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Dressing Up. Peppa and George are playing in Mummy and Daddy's bedroom.
lines.zh: 装扮游戏。佩奇和乔治在猪爸爸和猪妈妈的卧室里玩。

lines.en: What's this? Peppa has found a box of old clothes.
lines.zh: 这是什么？佩奇找到了一箱旧衣服。

lines.en: Wow! This is Daddy's hat, and this is Mummy's dress.
lines.zh: 哇！这是爸爸的帽子，这是妈妈的裙子。

lines.en: George, let's dress up and pretend to be Mummy and Daddy.
lines.zh: 乔治，我们来打扮一下，假装是妈妈和爸爸吧。

lines.en: Here is Daddy's hat, and here is Daddy's coat. Hello, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是爸爸的帽子，这是爸爸的外套。你好，猪爸爸。

lines.en: Now it's my turn. This is Mummy's dress. This is Mummy's hat.
lines.zh: 现在轮到我了。这是妈妈的裙子。这是妈妈的帽子。

lines.en: Daddy Pig, where are your shoes? I need some shoes, too.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你的鞋子呢？我也需要一双鞋。

lines.en: Now I need to look beautiful, just like Mummy.
lines.zh: 现在我要打扮得漂亮点，就像妈妈一样。

lines.en: Peppa has found Mummy's makeup box. Aha! First, some powder. Lovely!
lines.zh: 佩奇找到了妈妈的化妆盒。啊哈！先扑点粉。真好看！

lines.en: Now for some lipstick. What a pretty Mummy Pig!
lines.zh: 现在涂点口红。多漂亮的猪妈妈呀！

lines.en: Come along, Daddy Pig. It's time to go to work.
lines.zh: 走吧，猪爸爸。该去上班了。

lines.en: Mummy Pig is working on her computer. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George. I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: 猪妈妈正在电脑上工作。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。你说什么？

lines.en: Peppa, I was just saying hello. I'm not Peppa Pig. I'm Mummy Pig. Oh, yes, of course. Hello, Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 佩奇，我刚才在打招呼呀。我不是小猪佩奇。我是猪妈妈。哦，对，当然。你好，猪妈妈。

lines.en: Hello, and this is Daddy Pig. George and hello to you, too, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 你好，这是猪爸爸。乔治，也向你问好，猪爸爸。

lines.en: Excuse me, I've got a lot of work to do.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我有很多工作要做。

lines.en: Hello? Yes, do this, do that. No, thank you. Goodbye.
lines.zh: 喂？好的，做这个，做那个。不用了，谢谢。再见。

lines.en: Peppa is enjoying pretending to be Mummy Pig, but George is getting a bit bored.
lines.zh: 佩奇很喜欢假装成猪妈妈，可乔治有点无聊了。

lines.en: Sorry, Daddy Pig, I'm nearly finished. There, all done. Come on, Daddy Pig, it's time you did some work.
lines.zh: 抱歉，猪爸爸，我快做完了。好了，全都做完了。走吧，猪爸爸，该你干活了。

lines.en: Goodbye, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 再见，猪妈妈和猪爸爸。

lines.en: Goodbye! Daddy Pig is digging in the garden. Hello, Peppa. Hello, George.
lines.zh: 再见！猪爸爸在花园里挖土。你好，佩奇。你好，乔治。

lines.en: I'm not Peppa. I'm Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig. Daddy Pig is here to do some work.
lines.zh: 我不是佩奇。我是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。猪爸爸是来干活的。

lines.en: That's very kind of you, Daddy Pig. Now, be careful, it's a very deep hole.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，你真是太好了。现在小心点，这个洞很深。

lines.en: I hope you are not digging in your best clothes, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，希望你不是穿着最好的衣服在挖土。

lines.en: I want to make big snorts.
lines.zh: 我也想大声哼哼。

lines.en: Ice cream, everyone! Ice cream!
lines.zh: 大家吃冰淇淋啦！冰淇淋！

lines.en: Peppa, George, you must take off those muddy clothes before you eat. I'm Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，吃东西前必须把脏衣服换掉。我是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Are you sure? Yes. So where are Peppa and George?
lines.zh: 你们确定吗？确定。那佩奇和乔治在哪里呢？

lines.en: We don't know. Oh, well, that's a shame, because I've got their favorite ice cream here.
lines.zh: 我们不知道。哦，那太可惜了，因为我这儿有他们最爱吃的冰淇淋。

lines.en: But if we can't find them... then here we are! Peppa! George! There you are.
lines.zh: 不过要是我们找不到他们……那我们就在这儿啦！佩奇！乔治！你们在这儿呀。

lines.en: Yes, Mummy. We were just pretending to be you and Daddy.
lines.zh: 是的，妈妈。我们刚才在假装成你和爸爸呢。

lines.en: You really had us fooled.
lines.zh: 你们真的把我们骗到了。
